ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Live in-person sessions held at Tate and Lyle will be May 17, May 24 and June 7 from 3pm to 6pm. Online sessions will use Elluminate course delivery system on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 5pm to 8pm. No Class Memorial Day May 31. Students will need high speed internet connection and a headset with microphone or external microphone with speakers to interact during the online class sessions.
